snippet.title: Cloverpit trailer - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
CloverPit is the demonic lovechild of Balatro and Buckshot Roulette that locks you in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM. With the help of charms and combos, players must manipulate the machine, pay off their debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!
